title: Create useAuthenticatedId hook to replace useVisitorId for auth users
description: Create a new hook that returns session.user.email when authenticated, falling back to localStorage visitorId only for anonymous users. This is the foundation fix for user data isolation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Hook returns localStorage visitorId when NOT authenticated
Hook handles loading state (returns empty string while loading)
Export hook from hooks index if exists

notes: Use authClient.useSession() to get auth state. Return session?.user?.email || visitorId. This hook will replace useVisitorId() throughout the app.
